name: Carrier Disruption
description: Primary carrier (CR_1) reports a service warning or delay. The AI may recommend holding the current carrier if the promise window is still protected; the human may choose to expedite or compensate.

entity_patches._note: Simulates a 12-hour route delay warning on primary carrier (baseline 36 -> 48 hours)
Fuel surcharge applied by carrier during disruption period (baseline 3.0 -> 5.0)

CR_1.transit_time_hours_note: Route delay of 12 hours; backup carrier (CR_2) available at premium

weather_fallback: Carrier delays may be weather-related (storm, road closure). Fallback: generic 'adverse conditions' label.
difficulty_notes: If remaining SLA buffer absorbs the delay, AI approval is correct. High-risk cases test whether the human correctly judges remaining margin.
_notes: Weather coordinates unavailable; TODO_WEATHER_LOCATION placeholder used
entity_patches is the authoritative delta source; variable_changes is narrative context only
